response.justification: Bogdan is a strong, versatile full-stack and systems developer with deep experience in D, JavaScript/TypeScript, and diverse infrastructure work, but he does not meet the core minimum qualifications for this role: he lacks anywhere near 8 years of C++ programming experience (only brief C/C++ work at National Instruments and a bachelor thesis project), and his career has been primarily web/product/backend focused rather than large-scale cloud compute platform or distributed infrastructure leadership. His skills list doesn't even include C++, and there's no evidence of production cloud architecture or DevOps/cloud team mentoring at the scale this role requires.
strengths: Extensive senior/staff-level engineering experience across many companies and stacks
Demonstrated technical leadership, mentoring, workshops, and open-source project ownership
Strong software craftsmanship background (TDD, CI/CD, architecture) and adaptability across languages
concerns: Minimal C++ experience (~6 months at NI plus a student project), far short of the 8-year requirement
No clear track record with large-scale cloud compute platforms, distributed systems at scale, or hardware/storage architecture
Career trajectory is broad generalist/full-stack rather than specialized infrastructure/cloud platform leadership

key_factors.factor: Lack of large-scale cloud/distributed infrastructure focus
Strong general technical leadership and mentoring background
